certification.name: Entry-Level Penetration Tester Certification
certification.description: Entry-level penetration testing certification covering reconnaissance, internal networks, Active Directory, web and API testing, cloud, privilege escalation and reporting. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a scoped environment followed by 48 hours to write a penetration test report.
certification.currency_note: Course with lifetime access and one exam voucher that does not expire; page shows 'starting at' USD 700
